rationale: Selected 95 mm² as the smallest catalog section passing all three checks: (1) derated ampacity 298×0.96×0.8=228.9 A ≥ 180 A; (2) voltage drop calculated as sqrt(3)×180×0.25×(0.193×0.9+0.082×sin(arccos(0.9)))/400×100 = 4.08% ≤ 5%; (3) thermal withstand 95 mm² ≥ 53.07 mm² (12000×sqrt(0.4)/143). The 70 mm² section fails voltage drop at 5.40%.
